title: KCP contribution_redact result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 space/content mutation family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for contribution_redact (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The appended ContributionDisposition projection, kind redact, with the server-recorded payload_removed_at when bytes were removed (gap notes KG4/KG22).

kind.description: The §10.2 ContributionDisposition kind enum member this operation pins: contribution_redact always records kind redact (gap note KG22).

replacement_ref.description: The replacing contribution (§10.2 ?-marked); populated by supersession (gap note KG22).

reason_class.description: Disposition reason class token; no value space is pinned (gap note KG22).

contributionDispositionRedact.description: ContributionDisposition projection, field names verbatim from the §10.2 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG22).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

statusToken.description: Bounded lowercase token for a field DESIGN.md names without pinning a value space; pins the shape without inventing an enum (gap note KG6).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
